top_signals.title: VW Wants to Take On Wrangler and Bronco on Their US Home Turf
top_signals.summary:
Volkswagen AG is investing heavily in the US market, which Chief Executive Officer Oliver Blume says is "one big growth opportunity" for the company.
The company plans to enter the US market for light trucks and offroad sport utility vehicles, with projects including a software venture with Rivian Automotive Inc. and the revival of heritage brand Scout.
Volkswagen aims to field a midsize pickup and an offroad SUV to compete with established US franchises such as General Motors Co.'s Chevrolet Colorado and Ford Motor Co.'s Bronco. Bloomberg's Gabrielle Coppola breaks it all down on Bloomberg Intelligence (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: S&P 500 Bounces as Traders Buy Non-Chip Stocks: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders drove a rotation out of high-profile chipmakers and into a broader category of stocks while fueling a push toward the perceived safety of bonds.

top_signals.title: Los intentos de Trump para bajar el diésel, y sus límites
top_signals.summary:
El último dato de inflación en EE.UU. confirmó que el alza en los precios de los combustibles ya está golpeando el poder adquisitivo de los estadounidenses. Es misma presión está complicando el panoreama electoral para los republicanos frente a las elecciones de noviembre.

Desde la Casa Blanca, Kate Sullivan explica.  (Source: Bloomberg)
